title: AgentPolicyUpdateRequest
description: Partial update to an agent's policy. Only provided fields will be updated; omitted fields retain their current values.

permissions.description: Updated list of permissions. Replaces the entire permissions list when provided.

AgentAccountRestrictions.description: Optional restrictions that limit the agent to specific accounts or override policy per account.

allowedAccountIds.description: If set, restricts the agent to operate only on the specified internal account IDs. Null means the agent can access all accounts.

accountRules.description: Per-account rules that override the agent's default policy for specific accounts.

AgentAccountRule.description: Per-account policy override that takes precedence over the agent's default policy for a specific account.

accountId.description: The internal account ID this rule applies to.

perTransactionLimit.description: Per-transaction limit override, in the smallest unit of the relevant currency. Null inherits from the agent's spending limits.

AgentApprovalThresholds.description: Thresholds that force approval for high-value transactions, overriding the default execution mode. When a transaction is denominated in a different currency than the threshold, Grid converts using the exchange rate at evaluation time.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code that the amount threshold is denominated in. Required when amount is set.

amount.description: If set, any transaction above this amount (in the smallest unit of the specified currency) will require explicit approval even when the agent's defaultExecutionMode is AUTO. Null means no threshold override.

AgentExecutionMode.description: Execution mode controlling whether agent actions require human approval. AUTO: The agent can execute actions autonomously without explicit approval. APPROVAL_REQUIRED: All agent actions require explicit human approval before execution.

AgentPermission.description: Permission granted to an agent that determines what actions it can perform. VIEW_TRANSACTIONS: Can list and retrieve transactions and account balances. CREATE_TRANSFERS: Can initiate same-currency transfers. CREATE_QUOTES: Can create cross-currency quotes. EXECUTE_QUOTES: Can execute cross-currency quotes. MANAGE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNTS: Can create and manage external accounts.

AgentSpendingLimitsUpdate.description: Partial update to spending limits. Only provided fields will be updated; omitted fields retain their current values.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code that all amount limits are denominated in. Updating this recasts all existing limits into the new currency denomination.

dailyLimit.description: Maximum daily spend. Set to null to remove the daily limit.

dailyTransactionLimit.description: Maximum number of transactions per day.

monthlyLimit.description: Maximum monthly spend. Set to null to remove the monthly limit.
